description: This Java class 'DefaultSignalEnrichmentConfig' implements 'SignalEnrichmentConfig' and handles configuration data for signal enrichment, including provider details and associated config. It includes methods for creating instances from Config objects, accessing configuration values, and rendering configuration data.

classes.name: DefaultSignalEnrichmentConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing SignalEnrichmentConfig, encapsulating provider info and configuration details with utility methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance from a Config object, applying default fallback.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the signal enrichment provider name.

methods.name: getProviderConfig
methods.description: Returns the provider configuration as a Config object.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates a Config object representing this instance's configuration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare provider and config fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode based on provider and config.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
